title: ESPR horizontal requirements on repairability, including a repairability score
notes: One of the two horizontal acts the 2025-2030 working plan selects, with indicative adoption years of 2027 and 2029. Anticipated, so no CELEX and no text: nothing derived from it may be presented as sourced. Recorded with NO product groups on purpose. The working plan says its scope 'could include products such as consumer electronics and small household appliances' and is 'to be refined during the preparatory study' — that is a candidate scope, and binding a product group to it would be exactly the class of invention this catalog exists to prevent. The passport obligation follows from ESPR Art. 9(1) applying to products covered by ecodesign measures rather than from any text of this act; it is undated, and every future binding will be provisional until the act is adopted.
